about_the_game:
Gain Of Squad

Enter the world where time itself is the battlefield. Gain Of Squad is a multiplayer first-person shooter where strategy, reflexes, and teamwork decide who controls the flow of history.

Two mega-corporations clash:

-ARCHEON Systems — disciplined, strategic, and experienced

-VOLTEX Dynamics — aggressive, chaotic, and tech-obsessed

At Early Access Launch, you can experience:

-Tactical 5v5 matches in dynamic, destructible environments

-The core portal & temporal rift mechanics that transport battles across shifting arenas

-Team-based combat that rewards coordination, skill, and strategy

Key Features:

-Fast-paced tactical FPS gameplay

-Strategic use of the environment and team coordination

-Anti-cheat systems and optimized servers for smooth battles

Join the Community:

Get early insights, share your ideas, and connect with other players on our official Discord. Be among the first to explore this new FPS experience.

🔗 Add Gain Of Squad to your wishlist and be ready when the full battle begins!

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains violence and blood as it is a battle royale and deatmatch FPS game.

name: GOS: Gain Of Squad

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen R5 1600 processor
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT

short_description: GOS: Gain Of Squad is a multiplayer FPS. Join the fight for time itself! Experience tactical 5v5 battles, dynamic arenas, and the portal & temporal rift mechanics. Choose your corporation, plan your strategy, and be among the first to shape the battlefield.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Turkish, Estonian
